title: Section 1: Flight Control Scope
description: Informative scope overview for Flight Control Suite Rev 1.0.

title: Triple-Modular IMU Failover
description: The flight control computer shall maintain triple-modular redundant attitude estimation during single IMU failure.

title: GPS Loss Dead-Reckoning Switchover
description: The navigation subsystem shall switch to inertial dead-reckoning within 200ms of GPS signal loss.

title: Kalman Position Drift Ceiling
description: Kalman filter position drift shall remain below 5.0 meters over any 60-second dead-reckoning interval.

title: Emergency Battery Bus Sustain
description: Emergency backup battery shall sustain primary avionics bus voltage above 24.0V for at least 30 minutes.

title: ARINC-429 Bus Overload Shedding
description: ARINC-429 telemetry bus scheduler shall drop non-critical frames when bus utilization exceeds 85 percent.

title: Hydraulic Actuator Bypass Protection
description: Hydraulic actuator servo loop shall detect pressure drop below 1800 PSI and engage bypass valve within 50ms.

title: Crash Memory AES-256 Encryption
description: Cockpit flight data recorder shall encrypt solid-state crash memory using AES-256-GCM at rest.
